shared_elements: large elongated zoomorphic creature carved from a single massive stone mass
reptilian/saurian head at one end of the elongated body
incised surface detail on the head suggesting eye, jaw or brow
rectilinear panel-like or scale-like motifs repeated along the flank
body oriented lengthwise, viewed in profile
justification: Both depict a single massive, elongated zoomorph seen in profile with a broad reptilian-looking head at one end and repeated rectilinear, plate- or scale-like incised motifs running along the flank behind it, which is a reasonably specific shared conception rather than a generic 'animal'. The biggest difference in depicted content is that A is fully modelled in the round with a distinct snout, defined body volume and short legs beneath, whereas B's creature is realised only as shallow incised relief on the face of a boulder, with no legs or clearly separated head form and much more geometric, panelled detailing.
